description:
Pixlie Prompt Coach helps you write better AI video prompts before you open the Pixlie studio.

• Enhance rough ideas into Pixlie-ready prompts (text-to-video, image-to-video, video restyle)
• Suggest negative prompts, camera moves, aspect ratio, and duration
• Build 3–5 shot storyboard outlines
• Curated examples and workflow tips

This app does NOT render video, sell subscriptions, or handle credits inside ChatGPT. When your prompt is ready, open https://pixlys.com/create to generate.

Made by Brightforge Software Inc.
